name: Design-app chrome around an edit
description: Dress an edit you already animated (a glyph that rotates, slides or has an anchor dragged) as a screen capture of a vector design app: a blue selection box with handles that follows the shape, optional anchor squares on its points, a live readout tooltip (dX / dY, W / H or Angle) that counts with the move, and an optional magenta smart-guide word. Everything is sampled from the real resolved shape, so it sits exactly on the edit; re-apply after re-timing. Animate the edit first (for anchor drags use editor.setShapeMorph with align "vertices"), then apply this over the same frames.
source: r11 every shot f7-1067: blue selection boxes + anchor squares, magenta guide words, translucent readout tooltip
r11 S1 'i' rotation readout 0.36, 2.88, 9.72 ... = 90 x easeInOutCubic

layerId.description: The edited shape layer (a rectangle, ellipse, path or outlined glyph).

readout.description: Tooltip lines: move = dX / dY, size = W / H, angle = Angle (rotation delta), position = X / Y.

anchors.description: Anchor squares on every path point (path / outlined-glyph layers only).

guide.description: Smart-guide word above the shape ('' = none), e.g. 'center' or 'anchor'.

decimalMark.description: Readout decimal mark (r11 uses the European comma).

length.description: How long the chrome stays, frames at 30 fps (cover the edit).
